description: Job schedules that skip weekends and public holidays, which cron cannot express: "3rd business day of the month at 09:00", "last business day", "every Monday, or the next business day if it is a holiday", or any cron with a holiday rule. Returns the next runs and whether it runs today. DST-aware. Use for payroll, billing, reports and batch jobs. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

adjust.description: For weekend/holiday dates. modified_following: next, unless that is next month, then previous. following/preceding work

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

day.description: 1–31 (31 = month end in short months) or "last"

expression.description: Cron, 5 or 6 fields, max 96 runs a day

from.description: Runs at or after: date, local datetime or ISO 8601. Default now

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

n.description: 1 = first business day of the month, -1 = last, -2 = second to last

rule.description: nth_business_day (n), day_of_month (day), weekly (weekdays), cron (expression). "last business day" and "first business day" work

workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat

name: business_day_schedule
title: Business-day job schedule
